page.layout: One page with a title, a subtitle, and two parallel columns of Scripture references (Cap. | Verf. | Pag.), with a catchword at the bottom right. Left column first, then right column. Faint mirrored text from the reverse side is not transcribed.

main_text.head: INDEX Locorum Scripturae quae hoc in opere explicantur, aut illustrantur.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side (faint mirrored numbers and words such as "1 Corinth.", "Román.", "Luc." traces, "140. 246", "1, 62, &c.") was left out, except where a line seemed to belong to the index. Several right-column entries (Daniel, Johan., Mich., Zach., Matth. rows) are partly obscured by ghosting; the numbers marked [?] and the signature are doubtful. The row order of the right column may be uncertain.
